title: Response-Informed Value Estimation for Cost-Aware Multi-Turn LLM Routing
abstract: arXiv:2610.23239v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-turn LLM routing selects a model at every turn before its response is available, yet task success is revealed only when the interaction ends, leaving each intermediate choice without a label of its own. Logged trajectories, however, retain the response each call produced, which exposes what each turn required and how well the chosen model served it, evidence that outcomes alone hide. We introduce RIVET (Response-Informed Value Estimation for Turn-Level Routing), which exploits this post-call evidence during training while keeping routing strictly pre-call at deployment. RIVET jointly trains two value estimators over a shared state-model representation: a deployable Routing Value Estimator that scores candidate models from pre-call information, and a training-only Response-Informed Value Estimator that additionally observes the realized response. Conditioning on the response turns response-induced return variation from residual nois

translated_title: 面向成本感知多轮LLM路由的响应信息价值估计
translated_abstract: 多轮LLM路由需要在每一轮对话中、在模型响应可用之前就选择模型，然而任务成功与否只有在整个交互结束时才能揭晓，这使得每个中间选择都缺少属于自己的标签。然而，记录下来的交互轨迹保留了每次调用所产生的响应，这揭示了每一轮对话所需要的内容以及所选模型对其服务的效果——而这些证据仅凭最终结果是看不到的。我们提出了RIVET（面向轮级路由的响应信息价值估计），该方法在训练阶段利用这种调用后的证据，同时在部署时保持路由严格在调用前完成。RIVET在共享的状态-模型表示之上联合训练两个价值估计器：一个是可部署的路由价值估计器，仅根据调用前信息对候选模型进行评分；另一个是仅用于训练阶段的响应信息价值估计器，它额外观察实际产生的响应。以响应为条件，能够将响应引起的回报变化从残余噪声中区分出来
tldr: 提出RIVET方法，在训练阶段利用每次调用后的实际响应信息为每一轮提供价值监督信号，而在部署时仅依赖调用前信息进行成本感知的多轮LLM模型路由。
en_tdlr: RIVET exploits post-call response evidence during training to provide turn-level value supervision for multi-turn LLM routing, while keeping deployment-time routing strictly pre-call, enabling cost-aware model selection.
